name: manual_a5d6d8
claim: A re-dispatch to board-only agents was ignored three times until it carried a criticism ledger that ingested every reviewer's points with an accept, modify or reject disposition and verified-false claims called out; after that the agents claimed, implemented, independently reviewed and a re-review reopened one defect before approving. Check the receipts for the model actually used (the sub-agents ran GPT-6.1 Terra medium, not the ruled GPT-6.2 Sol medium), verify each peer claim against source (a reviewer cited a lessons.audit.jsonl file that does not exist), and push once per repo as a plain fast-forward only after the coordinator reruns the tests.

decisions.notes: Gossip-bus dispatch of PT 521 and orama 526 jobs, 2026-11-25.

rationale: Gossip-bus dispatch of PT 521 and orama 526 jobs, 2026-11-25.
